domain_label: Multi-Exam Blueprint Catalog Spine (INBDE / USMLE Step 1 & 2 CK / TOEFL iBT-2026) — grounded exam-structure data
purpose: A method for storing the four target exams' official content architectures as verifiable, source-traced data that forms the spine of the study catalog: the INBDE 10 FK x 56 CC Domain of Dentistry, the USMLE Step 1 system x discipline x competency matrix and Step 2 CK task x system matrix, and the 2026 TOEFL four-section adaptive structure with band-average scoring — each figure carried with a [FACT-source]/[ESTIMATE]/[UNKNOWN] tag, no percentage or count invented, coaching deferred to the owning sibling, and the whole normalized into one catalog spine that feeds the KB2 tree and KB3 catalog objects.
assumptions: official primaries were HTTP-403-blocked on direct fetch this session (usmle.org content-outline pages and PDFs; jcnde.ada.org PDFs), so exact percentages/counts come from secondary aggregation of those outlines and are tagged [ESTIMATE], never asserted as fact
structural facts (number of axes, category names, section inventories) are corroborated across the official pages' own search summaries and tagged [FACT-source: URL]
the INBDE FK x CC blueprint and TOEFL section structure are consumed from the dental and toefl siblings; only the USMLE Step 1/2 blueprint is held natively (the named gap)
this KB stores blueprints as a hierarchy of nodes (structure), not as study advice or pathway coaching, which are deferred to dental/toefl/sched
no blueprint percentage, section count, item count, or per-FK/CC weight is invented; unreachable details are held [UNKNOWN] with the blocker named
exclusions: the verbatim officially-numbered enumeration of all 56 INBDE Clinical Content areas (JCNDE renders them as figure-images and returned 403; held [UNKNOWN], deferred to dental + a fetch run)
exam/pathway coaching and readiness judgement (dental for INBDE, toefl for TOEFL; USMLE coaching is out of scope with no owning sibling)
content decomposition of source material into cards/atomic claims (contenteng)
prerequisite/adaptive sequencing math and progress rollup (sched+learner; engage+uxguide)
the tree UX and the catalog-object/sharing model (KB2 and KB3 respectively)

glossary.term: INBDE Domain of Dentistry (10 FK x 56 CC)
glossary.definition: The INBDE content matrix of 10 Foundation Knowledge areas by 56 Clinical Content areas, every item integrating >=1 FK within a CC, with the 56 CC split into ~13 Diagnosis & Treatment Planning / ~23 Oral Health Management / ~20 Practice & Profession. [FACT-source: jcnde.ada.org Item Development Guide / Foundation Knowledge PDFs — shape corroborated across official-page summaries]; verbatim 56-CC list and per-FK/CC weights [UNKNOWN].

A multi-axis blueprint: Organ System (~18 categories + General Principles) x Discipline (Pathology, Physiology, Pharmacology, Biochemistry & Nutrition, Microbiology, Immunology, Gross Anatomy & Embryology, Histology & Cell Biology, Behavioral Sciences, Genetics) x Physician Competency/Task. [FACT-source: usmle.org Step 1 content outline — structure corroborated across official-page summaries]; all weights [ESTIMATE].

A Physician-Task (Diagnosis; Pharmacotherapy/Interventions & Management; Health Maintenance/Prevention; Ethics/Professionalism; Systems-Based Practice/Patient Safety) x ~13 Organ-System blueprint, deliberately integrative. [FACT-source: usmle.org Step 2 CK content outline]; all percentages [ESTIMATE].

Post-2026-01-21 TOEFL: 4 sections (Reading, Listening, Speaking, Writing) in one no-break sitting, Reading & Listening multi-stage adaptive, Speaking & Writing fixed, ~90 min. [FACT-source: ets.org TOEFL transformation announcement]; exact per-module item counts and on-test order [UNKNOWN].

A 1.0-6.0 CEFR-aligned band scale where the overall = the AVERAGE of the four section scores (NOT a 0-120 sum); ~2026-~2028 triple dual-reporting (band + 0-120 + CEFR). [FACT-source: ets.org TOEFL transformation announcement].

The provenance discipline binding on every blueprint figure: [FACT-source: URL] for a structural fact corroborated across the official pages' own summaries; [ESTIMATE] for every exact %/weight/count (secondary aggregation; primary 403-blocked; verify on live page); [UNKNOWN] for an unreachable detail with the blocker named. No number is invented and an [ESTIMATE] is never upgraded on aggregator agreement.

Because no USMLE advice sibling exists (unlike dental for INBDE, toefl for TOEFL), curric holds the USMLE Step 1/2 blueprint natively; usmle-kg is a data source, not an exam authority; USMLE study coaching is out of scope with the gap named. [FACT — remit map]

Where an exam publishes no per-node weight, the catalog is organized by coverage (breadth of areas) rather than a fabricated weighting; area counts drive breadth and only published source-traced weights drive any allocation display, and the two are never conflated. [FACT — method]

On any official exam-format change (USMLE outline revision; end of TOEFL 0-120 dual-reporting; JCNDE Domain update) the affected blueprint node is frozen for human_review and re-verified against the live page before dependent catalogs are trusted. [FACT — change-control obligation]

priority_rationale: The blueprint frame and provenance posture come first because every exam figure inherits the four-exam data contract and its [FACT-source]/[ESTIMATE]/[UNKNOWN] tags; the four exams' structures and their named [UNKNOWN]/[ESTIMATE] figures come next because they set what is verified and what must never be fabricated; the cross-cutting rules (no-upgrade-on-consensus, coverage-where-unpublished, node-not-advice, native-USMLE gap) then govern how the data is used; and the format-change freeze and the one-spine synthesis close the KB as the handoff to KB2/KB3.
